thread:
Asha Mehta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring throughput regressions on gen-serve during ramp events. Need owners, tickets, and a compact RACI. Keep it action-oriented.
Connor Flynn: I can own the immediate throughput mitigation (batching tweaks + worker cap). Will open a Jira and aim for 7bd.
Yara Silva: I'll own metrics + alert work. Will add a new "post-ramp tail-latency" metric and tune alerts.
Marcus Holt: I'll take rollout automation + canary rollback hooks. Also add to the recurring-incident tracker.
pm-bot: Create ticket INF-9451 assigned to Connor: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9451
Connor Flynn: INF-9451 created: gen-serve batching cap + worker caps. Plan: 1) conservative batching params 2) worker soft-limit 3) smoke + load tests 4) canary. Target 7bd.
Yara Silva: RACI suggestion: R: Connor (implementation), A: Asha (PM signoff), C: Yara (metrics), Marcus (canary infra), I: Eng-oncall + Support.
Asha Mehta: Add checkpoints: 48h plan update, 1-week demo, full rollout after 7bd. Handoff rule: if owner unavailable >3bd, reassign to rotation lead (Marcus).
Marcus Holt: I'll wire the canary pipeline; rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for 10m. Adding dashboard tile now.
Connor Flynn: Assigned INF-9451 to myself and labeled pm-followup + recurring-incident.
Yara Silva: Added metric and a 5m alert: tail-latency > 300ms. Linking INF-9451 in tracker.
Asha Mehta: Good. Keep short updates here and link PRs/patches. If pattern persists after rollout we'll consider a remediation sprint. Ping me @Asha if blocked. :white_check_mark:
